description_en: Adds authorized users to a shared cloud computer. Cloud computers within the shared cloud computer are automatically assigned to authorized users based on rules set by the administrator
description_zh: 为共享型云电脑添加授权用户。共享型云电脑内的云电脑会按照管理员设置的规则自动分配给授权用户使用
kebab_example: aliyun ecd add-user-to-desktop-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-2i8qxpv6t1a030000 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --end-user-ids alice --desktop-group-ids dg-kadkdfaf0000 --user-ou-path example.com --user-group-name '研发组' --simple-user-group-id ug-3f6c8a2b0000 --org-id org-aliyun-wy-org-id --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddUserToDesktopGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared cloud computer to which you want to add authorized users
parameters.help_zh: 要添加授权用户的共享型云电脑ID
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The list of users to authorize
parameters.name: end_user_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of shared cloud computer IDs
parameters.name: desktop_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The organizational unit (OU) path of the user
parameters.name: user_ou_path

parameters.help_en: The organization ID of the team
parameters.name: org_id
